correctness.rationale: Five parameters avoiding branch values yield twenty simple roots of the hyperelliptic polynomial and genus9. The explicit maps (t,y)->(t,-y),(-t,-y),(1/t,-y/t^10) preserve the model, commute and produce eight automorphisms; fixed-point computations single out exactly three free involutions once full Aut has order8. For a=(2,3,4,5,6), reduction modulo 719 gives exactly the twenty listed rational branch points. Independent full 20*19*18=6840 projectivity image-triple enumeration yields only t,-t,1/t,-1/t on the roots. Since every branch root is rational, this exhausts geometric stabilizers as well. Hyperelliptic lifting bounds geometric special-fiber Aut by 8. In char0, Hurwitz |Aut|<=672<719 excludes the 719-primary kernel of good-reduction specialization, forcing exactly eight at the rational point. Automorphism-size upper-semicontinuity gives exact eight on a Zariski-open dense parameter set. The free involution subgroup is intrinsic, yielding unique genus3 quotient. This extrapolation uses a legitimate geometric specialization theorem, not just the finite-field experiment.
